entry.title: Musician's Toolkit 1.0.0
entry.content:
Musician's Toolkit

A chord library, a tuner, a metronome, a strumming trainer, a circle of fifths, a tap tempo and a note drill, for guitar, ukulele and piano. All of it lives in one small panel that stays on top of your other windows, so you can keep it beside your DAW, tab app or video lesson.

Press Win+Y to open it and pick a tool from the menu in the top left. Ctrl+Tab cycles through them. Close it with the x, with Esc, or with the shortcut again (the shortcut itself is under Settings > Shortcut). If you would rather it close whenever you click elsewhere, turn that on under Settings > Placement.

Chords

Start typing and the chord appears as you go: the list narrows with every letter, and the one you settle on is drawn underneath.

  • Guitar and ukulele get a fretboard, with barre positions, open strings and muted strings all marked.
  • Piano lights up the keys you would hold.
  • Fingerings - the arrow keys, or the slider under the diagram, step through the other ways to play the same chord.
  • Hear it - the speaker on the card plays the chord, strummed on an acoustic guitar or played on a piano.

Tap Tempo

Tap the big circle with the mouse, a touchpad or Space, and the panel works the tempo out from the timing. The bars beneath it show how steady you are being, so you can watch yourself settle.

  • Half and Double jump to half time or double time.
  • Reset clears the taps and starts a fresh count.
  • The scroll wheel nudges the BPM a step at a time.

Metronome

Set a meter and a tempo, and you have a click that keeps time while you play.

  • Meters - the chips cover 4/4, 3/4, 2/4, 5/4, 6/8, 7/8, 9/8 and 12/8; the steppers reach the rest, such as 5/8, 11/8 or 7/16.
  • Sound - a bright click marks the downbeat, a lower one each beat and a soft tick the subdivisions, so the bar reads as a pulse.
  • Tempo - the arrows or the wheel step the BPM, or click the number (or just start typing) and enter an exact one. Enter sets it, Esc leaves it as it was.
  • Background - the metronome keeps playing after you close the panel, which is what you want mid-piece. Switch it off under Settings > Metronome.

Tuner

Play a note and the needle tells you where you are. The display names the note and the arc shows how far off it is, so you can watch it settle in.

  • Tunings - standard, drop and open guitar tunings, several basses, ukuleles, mandolins, banjos, the violin family, lap steel, dobro and bouzouki.
  • Anything else - the tuner falls back to a chromatic scale, so a restrung or homemade instrument tunes just as well.
  • Pitch - concert pitch is adjustable from 415 to 466 Hz (A4 = 440 by default) under Settings > Tuner.

Strumming Pattern

Lay out a bar of strums on a one-measure grid and hear it back in the same acoustic voice as the chord library, in time with the tempo.

  • Pattern - the list is grouped by the grid each pattern is written in, and holds the ones people actually play: downstrokes, steady eighths, D DU D DU, the folk D DU UDU, D D D U D U, the reggae skank, a muted chug, a shuffle and straight sixteenths, plus the 2+2+3 and 3+2+2 groupings that odd meters are counted in. Picking a pattern moves the grid chips to the grid it was notated in, so it arrives ready to play.
  • Grid - click a cell to cycle rest, down, up, muted down and muted up, or walk the bar with the arrow keys and type one letter: D down, U up, X muted downstroke, M muted upstroke, R rest.
  • Marks - A accents a stroke, G turns it into a ghost note and T ties it into the next cell so it rings on past the beat. C clears the bar. None of the keys need a modifier, and every one of them is hinted along the foot of the card.
  • Strings - pick guitar or ukulele, then fret a chord from the list or leave the strings open, so the pattern rings with a voicing you would really use.
  • Sound - open strums ring out, palm mute damps them into a rhythm and muted turns every stroke into a scratch. A stroke written as a mute stays a scratch whatever the sound is set to.
  • Meter - 4/4, 3/4, 2/4, 5/4, 6/8, 7/8, 9/8 or 12/8. The grid chips read against the meter's own unit, so 6/8 counts in eighths and its chips offer 1/8, 1/16, triplet and 1/32.
  • Practice - count-in, loop, and practice mode, which lifts the tempo a little at the start of every bar until you reach your target.
  • Tempo - the minus and plus buttons nudge the BPM, or click the number (or start typing) to enter one. Enter sets it, Esc cancels.

Circle of Fifths

All twelve keys around a ring, each a fifth on from the last. Click either ring to select a key and hear it, and the rest of the wheel reads back from that selection.

  • Wheel - the majors on the outer ring, their relative minors inside on the same spoke. Scroll or use the arrow keys to walk the circle, and press Up / Down (or M) to hop between the rings without leaving the fifth.
  • Chords of the key - I, IV and V carry their numeral outside, ii, iii and vi inside, so the six chords you would normally play are always in view. A minor key lights them the other way round.
  • Centre - the tonic and its seven notes. A minor key uses the natural minor, so A minor reads A B C D E F G rather than the major scale of A.
  • Theory - the key signature, the relative and parallel keys, and the mode built on each degree.
  • Instrument - pick guitar, piano or ukulele (or press Tab) to hear the scales and chords in that voice.
  • Hear it - click one of the seven diatonic chips, or press 1–7.

Note Trainer

A drill for knowing your instrument. A note name appears, the microphone listens and you play it before the clock runs out.

  • Round - Space starts and stops, and each prompt gets its own timer of 2–20 seconds per note, set under Settings > Note trainer.
  • Listening - a note counts the moment it settles in tune, and the readout under the prompt shows what the microphone hears right now.
  • Feedback - a correct note flashes green with the points it earned; a miss shows the note it was looking for before the next prompt appears.
  • Score - a quick answer is worth up to twice a slow one, and the panel keeps your streak, best streak and accuracy. R resets it.
  • Voices - Tab cycles guitar, ukulele and piano, and N (or the Naturals chip) keeps the drill to the white notes.

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Win+Y - open or close the panel.
  • Ctrl+Tab - switch tools.
  • Tab - switch instruments.
  • Up / Down - move through search results, step the metronome, hop between the rings of the circle.
  • Left / Right - step through fingerings, halve or double a tap tempo, change the metronome's meter.
  • D U X M R, A G T, C - lay strokes in the strumming grid, add accents, ghosts and ties, clear the bar.
  • Esc - clear the search, or close the panel when the search is empty.

Settings

  • Startup - the tool and instrument the panel opens with.
  • Appearance - follow Windows or fix light or dark, pick an accent colour, set the opacity.
  • Placement - corner, monitor, fine offsets, and whether the panel closes when it loses focus.
  • Shortcut - the key and modifiers that open the panel.
  • Metronome - volume, background playback, default meter and subdivision.
  • Chords - hide the finger numbers.
  • Tap tempo - how long a pause resets the taps, and whether Space or Enter count as taps.
  • Tuner - reference pitch.
  • Strumming - default grid, count-in, loop, and the practice ramp.
  • Circle of fifths - which ring opens, and whether selecting a key plays its scale.
  • Note trainer - seconds per note, chromatic or naturals.

The chord library comes from chords-db by David Rubert (MIT). It is packed into the mod, so there is nothing to download and no internet connection needed.

entry.title: Turn Off Display Without Sleep 1.0.0
entry.content:
Turn Off Display Without Sleep

On Modern Standby (S0ix) laptops, user-initiated actions—such as clicking "Sleep" in the Start menu, pressing a power button configured for sleep, or invoking display-off shortcuts—instruct the Windows Power Dependency Coordinator (PDC) to transition to sleep. This suspends desktop apps (DAM) and disconnects mobile hotspots.

However, when Windows turns the display off through a natural idle timeout, Modern Standby keeps audio streams, downloads, and mobile hotspots running indefinitely.

Turn Off Display Without Sleep triggers this natural idle path on demand:

  1. Instant Pitch-Black Screen: Creates an instant fullscreen topmost blackout overlay across all monitors so the screen appears turned off immediately.
  2. Dynamic 1-Second Timeout: Saves your current timeouts and temporarily injects a 1-second display idle timeout (VIDEOIDLE) into the active power scheme. Windows naturally powers down the monitors via the idle path within ~1–2 seconds without suspending background tasks.
  3. Automatic Restoration: When hardware display-off (GUID_CONSOLE_DISPLAY_STATE == 0) is detected, the original display timeout is immediately restored, and the overlay is dismissed.
  4. Direct-to-Desktop Wake or Optional Lock:
    • By default, your workstation stays unlocked so you return directly to your active desktop upon waking the screen—no PIN or Windows Hello delay.
    • If desired, enable Lock workstation after display turns off to silently lock the session in the dark once the screen is powered down.
  5. Failsafe Watchdog: If the display does not power down within 3 seconds (e.g. due to mouse movement or an application holding ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED / active video playback), the overlay is removed and timeouts are restored automatically.

What happens on an unclean exit?

The 1-second timeout only exists in the power plan for the 1–3 seconds between trigger and display power-down. If the tool process is forcefully terminated during those few seconds (system crash, power loss, or process kill), the 1-second timeout remains in the active power plan until the mod runs again and automatically restores it from storage. If the screen turns off after one second of idle while the mod is disabled or uninstalled, simply re-adjust "Turn off my screen after" in Windows Settings.

Prerequisites

To allow this mod to take control of lid-close or power button events, Windows native actions must be set to "Do nothing" (0) so Windows does not trigger its built-in sleep transition.

Run this in an elevated Command Prompt:

powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS PBUTTONACTION 0
powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS PBUTTONACTION 0
powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS LIDACTION 0
powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS LIDACTION 0
powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

Warning: With the lid action set to "Do nothing", closing the lid and putting the laptop into a backpack or bag will keep the system running (until the regular system sleep timeout). Make sure to explicitly sleep or shut down your laptop before bagging it.

Reverting prerequisites

If you disable or uninstall this mod and want to restore the native sleep behavior:

powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS PBUTTONACTION 1
powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS PBUTTONACTION 1
powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS LIDACTION 1
powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS LIDACTION 1
powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

Triggers

  • Keyboard Shortcut: Default is Win+Alt+L. Customizable in settings.
  • Lid Close: Triggered automatically when closing the laptop lid. Requires native lid close action set to "Do nothing".
  • Power Button: Supported on devices where the power button is exposed via HID System Control (Usage Page 0x01, Usages 0x80/0x81/0x82 or 0x0D, such as Microsoft Surface Pro). Requires native power button action set to "Do nothing". Not detectable on laptops with ACPI-only power buttons, use Trigger hotkey or Lid close instead.
  • External Window Message: Broadcast WindhawkScreenOffNoSleep_Trigger from external scripts or taskbar shortcuts.

Settings

  • Lock workstation after display turns off: Silently lock in the dark after screen is off.
  • Trigger hotkey: Global hotkey to turn off display (default Win+Alt+L).
  • Turn off display on lid close: Trigger when laptop lid closes.
  • Turn off display on power button (HID devices): Capture HID power button events.

entry.title: Siri Plus Launchpad 1.1.0
entry.content:
New

  • Search everything (Original Siri): typing in "Search" lists apps, actions, folders and files together in one list, like Spotlight. "Show all" opens the category with what you typed. Can be turned off.
  • Windows Settings in the search: about 60 Settings pages (Display, Startup apps, Personalization, Windows Update, Wi-Fi...) are found by name or by what you would type to look for them, and open with Enter. They follow the Actions tab being on.
  • Right-click a file or folder found by the search: "Open file location" shows it in File Explorer.
  • Calculator: type a calculation (2+2, 15% * 80, (3+4)^2) and its result shows first; Enter copies it. Start with = or calc to always calculate (=5-3). Can be turned off.
  • New settings window in the style of macOS System Settings: it grows out of the bar, its content comes in step by step, and it switches off in place like an old TV (CRT) when closed. A search field sits on top of the sections.
  • Settings reorganized into 12 sections (General, Appearance, Custom theme, Search, Siri bar, Results size, Window and Fullscreen, Animations, Keyboard shortcuts, Apps and icons, Performance, Backup and defaults), with group titles and a short description for every setting.
  • Settings that have no effect with your current choices are dimmed in gray, say why, and turn blue again when they can be used; whole sections (such as Custom theme) dim the same way.
  • Glass style: Translucent glass (flat glass with a soft live blur, light on the PC) or Liquid glass (the background bends at the edges, Floating and Original Siri modes); the description follows the choice.
  • Performance: Light mode works with any theme (no liquid glass, no live blur, no blur behind menus, no shadows, at most 60 fps, calmer animations), a frame rate limit, and an experimental option to draw with the processor instead of the graphics card.
  • Clear glass theme: the selection in menus can be Glass, Colored (like macOS) or Frosted color, with a color of your choice.
  • Floating power button: left or right of the bar.
  • Create desktop shortcut in an app's right-click menu (also for several selected apps).
  • Floating mode: the category icon in the bar turns into a back arrow, as in Original Siri.
  • The "..." button turns into a soft gear under the mouse.
  • Blinking text cursor in the bar and in the settings search.
  • Simplified Chinese (follows Windows, or pick it in Language).

Changed

  • A single "Change icon..." option: it opens your icon folder (asked for the first time). The single-file picker was removed.
  • New defaults: Siri bar height 96 px; floating power button off. Users who changed these keep their values.
  • Settings that only apply to some modes say so in their description, in Windhawk's settings too.

Fixed

  • Clear areas of the glass let the mouse through, which made the settings button and the result rows slow to respond or skip; they now answer right away.
  • Folder, file and color pickers are no longer covered by the launcher or its glass.
  • Backspace with an empty search no longer switches to Applications.
  • Faster drawing: shadows, gradients, settings reads and the blur behind menus are cached, and the settings rows are only rebuilt when they change.

entry.title: Logitech Battery Tray 0.1.2
entry.content:
Logitech Battery Tray

Battery indicators for supported Logitech devices, with automatic discovery, charging status and optional percentage labels.

Screenshots

Horizontal taskbar with a battery tooltip:

Vertical taskbar with stacked device indicators:

Compatibility and scope

Windows 10/11: standard notification icons provide the compatibility backend. On supported Windows 11 x64/ARM64 taskbars, Auto uses native XAML battery buttons on the primary taskbar. Unrecognized taskbar layouts use notification icons instead of an overlay. 32-bit Windows uses notification icons only. Native icons show the percentage and a tooltip; charging is green. Windows controls their placement and overflow visibility. XAML placement, button styling and click-to-open settings do not apply to notification icons.

Select Native notification icons to test or force the compatibility backend. Successful compilation is not a claim of runtime testing on every Windows build.

Unlike BT Battery Monitor (generic Bluetooth battery reporting), this mod reads Logitech G HUB and Logitech HID++ battery data, including supported USB receivers. It runs in Explorer because its optional XAML backend modifies Explorer's own taskbar visual tree. No pairing, firmware or device configuration is changed.

Battery sources

The XAML backend uses built-in Segoe Fluent Icons and standard Windows buttons and tooltips. Its battery glyph changes with the reported charge level, with an optional smaller icon indicating the device type.

G HUB must be running to use its data; direct HID++ reading works independently. The G HUB client connects only to 127.0.0.1:9010. It requests /devices/list and /battery/<deviceId>/state, subscribes to /battery/state/changed, and uses a persistent query connection with a 30-second fallback poll by default. Failed connections retry with exponential backoff, up to 60 seconds. Events update readings independently of fallback polling. Updates cannot arrive earlier than G HUB reports them.

The HID++ provider reads compatible Logitech devices through Unifying, Bolt, LIGHTSPEED, USB and accessible Bluetooth HID++ interfaces. It supports battery features 0x1004, 0x1000, 0x1001, 0x1F20 and legacy HID++ 1.0 registers. Voltage-based and coarse readings are marked with an approximation sign. G HUB readings take priority when available. Models using other protocols may not report a battery level; support for every Logitech model is not guaranteed.

Discovery and language

All detected, supported battery devices are shown by default. No model-specific rules are shipped. Optional visibility rules match a device name or model; empty rules are ignored, * and ? are supported, and the last match wins. The user-facing tooltip contains no internal IDs or provider diagnostics. Tooltip translations follow the preferred Windows UI languages, with English as fallback. Reload the mod after changing Windows display languages. The mod description and settings default to English, with Russian localization for Windhawk's Russian interface. Tooltips follow Windows UI languages independently.

When G HUB stops, HID++ provides readings for compatible devices. Fully disconnected devices are hidden; confirmed charging remains visible even when the device is inactive. Repeated explicit HID++ offline reports and failed G HUB queries use a five-second grace. Missing HID++ replies are treated as an unknown connection state, retaining the last reading for up to thirty seconds of failed communication. A hidden HID++ device needs two valid readings at least one second apart before reappearing, with no intervening failed reading. These windows absorb temporary failures, not indefinitely cache charging state. Provider requests run outside the taskbar UI thread. Reconnection is automatic. Windows HID arrival/removal and receiver notifications trigger rediscovery; three-minute scanning also handles devices that do not send connection events. An already-open device that missed its initial probe is retried separately, with increasing delays up to 60 seconds, without rescanning every HID interface. Event-capable HID++ features use the configured fallback interval. ADC (0x1F20) and legacy register devices use a two-second poll because they may lack events. Presence confirmation temporarily uses a short interval to avoid delayed recovery. The XAML UI updates on data, size and theme changes, without a periodic repaint. In Auto mode, a transient XAML failure must last 30 seconds before notification icons appear; missing taskbar symbols select the compatibility backend immediately. While the native fallback is active, unsuccessful XAML attachment attempts back off up to 60 seconds. Layout, DPI and theme changes trigger an immediate retry. On supported left/right taskbars, indicators are stacked vertically and the percentage is placed below the icons. Button width follows the taskbar width; the configured button width applies to horizontal taskbars only.

Credits and limitations

Disable direct HID++ reading before updating device firmware. Persistent HID handles are read-only; write access is opened only for each battery/probe request. This reduces sharing conflicts, but cannot guarantee compatibility with tools that require exclusive access. Firmware updates with this mod have not been tested.

The G HUB interface is unofficial and may change with G HUB updates. XAML root access is adapted from Taskbar Folder Menus by sb4ssman: https://github.com/ramensoftware/windhawk-mods/blob/main/mods/taskbar-folder-menus.wh.cpp G HUB protocol: https://github.com/someweirdhuman/LogiBAT G HUB events: https://github.com/bmrussell/LGBattery Icons: https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/apps/design/iconography/segoe-fluent-icons-font HID++: https://github.com/Logitech/cpg-docs/tree/master/hidpp20 Battery features: https://github.com/pwr-Solaar/Solaar

entry.title: Classic Explorerframe for 24H2 and later 1.0
entry.content:
Restores classic Explorerframe.dll on Windows 11 24H2 and later. This allows to restore the toolbars in the folder windows, including the menubar, the Classic Explorer toolbar from OpenShell package, Quero toolbar and the toolbars provided by the mod Flexible Explorer Toolbars Deluxe, such as the Search bar.

Note that to enable the menubar you need to install in addition the mod ExplorerFrame and menubar fixes fork.

This mod downloads the classic Explorerframe.dll from the Microsoft's symbols server and stores it into the mod's storage. You need a working internet access at the first mod's activation.

Restart Explorer after enabling or disabling the mod. At the first activation the file is downloaded in the background, so wait a few seconds before restarting, otherwise the mod takes effect only at the following Explorer start.

Mods that hook ExplorerFrame.dll and happen to load before this mod might have no effect, because folder windows don't use the copy they hooked.

entry.title: Desktop Snowfall 1.0
entry.content:
Desktop Snowfall

Snow falls over your desktop. Flakes land on the top edge of your windows and on the taskbar and slowly build up snow drifts of different heights.

  • The snow follows the window. Toss a window up and the snow flies up in loose clumps and lands back with a little bounce. Pull it down or shrink it from the top and the snow hangs in the air for a moment before it falls back onto the window.
  • Make a window narrower and the snow on the cut-off part falls down.
  • Optionally, the snow slides off windows moved sideways: it stays where it is, and the part the window slides out from under falls down.
  • Sweep the snow off with the mouse cursor - it falls down to the windows below or to the taskbar.
  • The wind blows powder off the drifts, and now and then a lump slides off a window corner.
  • Works with the default taskbar, an auto-hidden taskbar (the snow rides along when it slides in and out) and custom taskbar styles (for example, floating "dock" themes of the Windows 11 Taskbar Styler mod): the snow lies on the visible taskbar parts.

The snow is drawn on the GPU on a transparent, click-through overlay, so it never gets in the way of mouse input. The overlay is hidden automatically while a fullscreen app (a game or a video) is in the foreground. The mod runs in its own process, separately from Explorer.

The overlay is redrawn every frame, so the snow keeps the GPU a little busy even when nothing else on the screen changes. On a laptop running on battery, a lower frame rate limit (for example, 30) saves power.

entry.title: Ubuntu Unity Desktop 1.0
entry.content:
Ubuntu Unity Desktop

Turns Windows 11 into the Ubuntu Unity 7 desktop (Ubuntu 12.04 - 16.04): a panel along the top, the launcher along the left and the Dash instead of the Start menu. Everything runs inside Explorer: there is no separate program to install, and turning the mod off gives you the normal Windows desktop back right away.

What you get

The panel (top bar)

  • The title of the window in front, and for a maximized window its minimize / restore / close buttons: the window loses its own title bar, like in Unity.
  • Tabs in the panel: maximize a browser (Brave, Chrome, Edge, ...) or another window with tabs and its whole tab row moves into the panel, with the sites' icons. Click a tab to switch, x to close it, + for a new one.
  • Drag a maximized window down out of the panel to restore it, and drop it back on the panel to maximize it.
  • Indicators on the right: background apps (tray icons), keyboard language, network, messages, volume (with a slider), clock (with a calendar) and the session menu (lock, log out, restart, shut down).

The launcher (left bar)

  • Pinned and running apps, with a pip per open window and an arrow for the app in front. Click to open, switch or minimize; right-click to pin / unpin, run as administrator, open the file location or quit.
  • Hover for the app's name and live previews of its windows.
  • Drag icons to reorder them, onto each other to make a group, or off the launcher to unpin them.
  • Music controls (cover, play / pause, previous / next) slide open under the app that plays music.
  • Discord call buttons (mute, deafen, hang up) slide open under Discord while you're in a call.
  • Drag the launcher's right edge to make it (and its icons) bigger or smaller. The trash sits at the bottom.

The Dash (Start menu)

  • Opens with the Windows key, Ctrl+Esc or the button at the top of the launcher.
  • Type to search apps, settings and files; lenses and filters like Unity's; widgets (clock, music, weather app, system, disks) on Home.
  • Resize it with the grip in its corner (the size is remembered) or maximize it.

And more

  • Unity's animations: windows fly into the launcher when minimized, the launcher icons pop and wiggle, the panel and launcher slide away for full-screen games and videos.
  • Glass (blur or acrylic), your accent colour or any colour, dark (Ambiance) or light (Radiance) panel.

Settings

Everything can be adjusted in the mod's settings, grouped by panel, launcher, Dash, look, windows and Windows integration: sizes, opacity, glass, clock format, which indicators show, animation speed, tabs in the panel, and whether the Windows taskbar is hidden.

Good to know

  • Windows 11, 64-bit. The shell lives on the main screen. With the taskbar hidden, other screens have no taskbar (and no launcher) at all; their windows stay where they are.
  • The taskbar's "automatically hide" setting is turned on while the mod runs (that gives its room on the screen back) and is set back as it was when you turn the mod off. If Explorer is killed or crashes and the mod is removed before it runs again, it may stay on: switch it off under Settings > Personalization > Taskbar.
  • The Windows key and Ctrl+Esc open the Dash; shortcuts like Win+E, Win+R and Win+Shift+S keep working. If Windows' own Start menu opens anyway, the mod closes it and shows the Dash.
  • Tabs in the panel read the window's tabs through Windows' accessibility interface. They work best with Chromium browsers (Brave, Chrome, Edge, Vivaldi, Opera). The new-tab button and the Discord call buttons are found by their names in English and Dutch apps.
  • The shell's texts are in English, or in Dutch when Windows is.
  • The Dash's weather card opens Windows' own Weather app: the mod itself never connects to the internet.

entry.title: Window Centralizer 1.1.0
entry.content: • New toggle to show windows only after complete UI load, avoiding the native elements flicker of some interfaces.

entry.title: Top Taskbar Bleed 1.1.1
entry.content:
• Periodic (10 s) island health check on the taskbar thread: detached panels are re-attached and committed to again, live ones repaired (position above the background, visibility, opacity, stroke and fill state), each repair logged; the check touches only what the mod itself placed or changed, so Styler themes, Dynamic Taskbar Transparency and the Opacity Tuner are left alone

  • An update that finds its panel detached prunes the island and triggers the discovery retry instead of dropping silently

  • A Peek state that can no longer be alive (cursor away from the taskbar and nothing of Explorer’s showing a thumbnail or switcher for 1 s) is cleared; the Peek hook logs on/off and what kept a Peek alive

  • New setting “Transparent taskbar when nothing is maximized”: the taskbar’s own background and border line are hidden, so the wallpaper shows through whenever no bleed is showing - the taskbar is either bled or transparent, never stock. The mod saves and restores the elements’ own values rather than writing Visible / 1.0, so other mods’ settings survive; taskbars the mod leaves idle (a bottom taskbar without Any taskbar position) keep their background

  • Task View (Win+Tab) and any window opaque over the top 16 px of the title bar (a full-screen app or overlay) hide the panel until they are gone, recovering one frame after

  • The Alt+Tab switcher, taskbar flyouts, light-dismiss overlays, the input-language switcher and other shell chrome never count as covers

  • Screen-recorder frames (region-shaped windows, like ShareX’s) no longer count as covers; a thin border lying on the sampled row moves the sample down past it

  • The sampled row is now the 4th row of the title bar

  • README updated

entry.title: Background Dimmer 1.1.0
entry.content:
• Taskbar, Start, Alt+Tab and notification center now count as focused: while one of them has focus, every regular window is dimmed. Previously they left the layer where it was, so the last active window stayed lit behind them.
  • A dialog now can dim the window that owns it (enabled by default). The new option "Dim a window while one of its dialogs has focus" can be turned off to keep them lit together, as in 1.0.0.
  • New option "Dim everything behind an open menu" (off by default). It works with standard Windows menus; apps that draw their own menus aren't detected. Without it, a menu keeps the window that opened it lit.
  • "Hide the layer from screenshots and screen sharing" is now on by default. Existing users keep their saved choice.
  • Optional tray icon (new "Tray icon" setting, off by default): click to open the configuration window, right-click to toggle dimming on and off.
  • Patterns simplified to Solid, Checkerboard, Stripes and Image, with a new Rotation slider for stripes and checkerboard (any angle, antialiased). Saved horizontal, vertical and diagonal stripes are converted to Stripes at 0°, 90° and 45°.

entry.title: WinKlok 1.1.0
entry.content:
• Added a custom notification panel.
  • Improved animations for smoother transitions.
  • Fixed the taskbar auto-hide bug.

Providers

Sign-in

  • Fix a new sign-in being overwritten by a token refresh that was already running.

Settings and notifications

entry.title: Lock Screen Live Wallpaper 1.0.0
entry.content:
Lock Screen Live Wallpaper

Plays a video as the background of the Windows 11 lock screen and the password / sign-in screen.

Preview video: "Stelle Cosmic Cheerleader" by u/iTaiizor, source. Character © HoYoverse. The video is not included in this mod.

The mod runs inside LogonUI.exe, decodes your video with Media Foundation, and feeds the frames into the XAML image elements that Windows normally uses for the lock screen wallpaper. If something looks wrong, a built-in fail-safe restores the original wallpaper.

⚠️ Before you start ⚠️

LogonUI.exe is a protected system process, so Windhawk does not inject into it by default. For this mod to work you must add it to Windhawk's process inclusion list:

  1. Open Windhawk and go to Settings → Advanced settings → More advanced settings.
  2. Add LogonUI.exe to the Process inclusion list and save.

📋 Requirements

  • Windows 11
  • LogonUI.exe added to Windhawk's process inclusion list (see above)
  • A video file that the SYSTEM account can read. LogonUI.exe runs as SYSTEM, so network locations, encrypted folders, and cloud-only (not downloaded) files may not work.

⚙️ Features

Feature Details
Video source One video file, or a folder (a random video is picked on every lock)
Formats mp4, m4v, mov, wmv, avi, mkv (anything Media Foundation can decode on your system; H.264 MP4 is recommended)
Fit modes Cover, fill, fit (letterbox), center
Playback speed 25% to 400%
Hardware decoding Decodes on the GPU (D3D11/DXVA) when possible, with automatic fallback to software decoding
Color adjustments Hue, saturation, brightness, contrast, gamma
Audio Plays the video's audio track when the volume is above 0
Power saving Still-frame mode, pause when idle, and optional pause on the password screen
Boot behavior Optionally show the last frame right after boot instead of decoding
Shutdown screen Optionally show the video on the "Shutting down" / "Restarting" screen (off by default, so Windows' own black screen is shown)
Fail-safe Restores the original wallpaper if the lock screen UI changes or the mod misbehaves
Debug log Optional CPU and decode statistics and a UI tree dump

📝 Notes on some settings

  • Render width: internal canvas width (320 to 1920). The height follows your screen's aspect ratio. This is the biggest CPU lever.
  • Hardware video decoding: on (default) decodes with the GPU when possible, which greatly lowers CPU use for 4K or 60 fps videos. Turn it off if playback glitches or the sign-in screen has problems. If the GPU path cannot produce a frame, the mod falls back to software decoding by itself. Changing this setting also re-enables playback if the crash guard turned it off.
  • Behavior right after boot: with Show last frame, the first 3 minutes after boot show the last saved frame without decoding. Needs at least one earlier session where the video was playing.
  • Audio volume: 0 means muted. Above 0, audio only plays at 100% speed while the video is playing (not paused, idle-paused, or showing the boot still frame).
  • Pause when idle: freezes the video and mutes the audio after the chosen time without input, and resumes on the next input.
  • Play video on the password screen: on (default) keeps the video playing while you type your password. Off freezes it on the password screen, which can help if playback stutters there, and it plays again on the lock screen.
  • Debug log: also writes debug.log in the mod's storage folder, with CPU and decode statistics every 5 seconds and one UI tree dump. Basic events always go to Windhawk's log (enable logging for the mod in Windhawk to see them).
  • Long playback: the video loops without any time limit. By default it freezes after 5 minutes without input (see Pause when idle); set that to 0 if you want it to keep playing while nobody is at the PC.

📈 Performance tips

  • Lower Render width (the default is 1920; for example try 1280 or 960).
  • Videos at 4K or 60 fps are decoded on the GPU when Hardware video decoding is on (the default). With it off they are decoded on the CPU and can use several cores; prefer 1080p at 30 fps then.
  • Use Pause if you only want a still image.
  • Keep Pause when idle enabled so nothing is decoded while nobody is at the PC.
  • If the video stutters while you type your password, turn off Play video on the password screen.
  • The password screen blurs the wallpaper behind it. A constantly changing background makes Windows redo that blur every frame, which costs some GPU time.

🔧 Troubleshooting

  • Normal wallpaper is shown: make sure LogonUI.exe is in the process inclusion list and the video path is correct, then turn on Debug log and read debug.log in the mod's storage folder (see "Files written by the mod"). Look for Failed to open video, Unsupported video format, or FAIL-SAFE TRIPPED. Enable Debug log for more detail.
  • Video will not open: try an H.264 MP4 stored somewhere the SYSTEM account can read.
  • No sound: set Audio volume above 0 and see the notes above.
  • Stuttering: lower the render width and enable Debug log, then check the CPU and UI stalls lines in the log.

🤔 How it works

  1. A worker thread finds the LogonUI Logon Window and installs a WH_GETMESSAGE hook on its UI thread.
  2. A decoder thread reads the video as RGB32 through Media Foundation, scales each frame according to the fit mode, applies the color settings, and publishes it to a shared buffer.
  3. On the UI thread, the newest frame is copied into a WriteableBitmap, which is set as the source of the LockLogonImage and SwapLockLogonImage elements.
  4. When the mod is unloaded, the original image sources are restored.

🛡️ Fail-safe

The mod stops itself and restores the original wallpaper for the rest of that LogonUI.exe process when:

  • the video decoder fails before producing any frame,
  • no video frame is produced within 30 seconds,
  • the lock screen elements (LockLogonImage / SwapLockLogonImage) are never found, which usually means a Windows update changed the UI, or
  • the UI throws repeated errors (3 within 30 seconds).

Separately, a crash guard protects the sign-in screen. If two LogonUI.exe sessions in a row end before the decoder shows its first frame (for example because a codec crashes on your video), the mod turns playback off and the normal wallpaper is shown. To turn it back on, change Video file or folder, Render width, Fit mode or Hardware video decoding to a different value and keep it. Very short sessions (for example two Ctrl+Alt+Del screens in a row) can also trip it; the same fix applies.

📁 Files written by the mod

Everything is stored in the mod's own storage folder inside Windhawk's data folder (the path below is for a regular install; a portable Windhawk keeps it elsewhere):

C:\ProgramData\Windhawk\Engine\ModsWritable\mod-storage\lock-screen-live-wallpaper

ProgramData is a hidden folder, so paste the path above into the File Explorer address bar to open it. The files are:

  • debug.log: log file, trimmed automatically after 2 MB
  • frame_*.bgra: cached first frame, so the lock screen can show something immediately
  • last.bgra: last shown frame, used by the Show last frame boot mode

You can delete these files at any time; the mod recreates what it needs. The folder is removed automatically when the mod is uninstalled.

☕ Support

If you enjoy this mod, you can support its development:

  • Ko-fi
  • Saweria (for Indonesia)

ℹ️ Disclaimer

Only tested on Windows 11 23H2 and 25H2. This mod runs inside a system UI process (LogonUI.exe), so it includes a fail-safe that restores the original wallpaper if anything goes wrong. As a precaution, keep another way to sign in available while trying it out.

Bahasa Indonesia

Memutar video sebagai latar belakang lock screen dan layar password / sign-in Windows 11.

Pratinjau video: "Stelle Cosmic Cheerleader" oleh u/iTaiizor, sumber. Karakter © HoYoverse. Videonya tidak disertakan dalam mod ini.

Mod ini berjalan di dalam LogonUI.exe, men-decode videomu dengan Media Foundation, lalu memasukkan frame-nya ke elemen gambar XAML yang biasanya dipakai Windows untuk wallpaper lock screen. Jika ada yang tidak beres, fail-safe bawaan akan mengembalikan wallpaper asli.

⚠️ Sebelum mulai ⚠️

LogonUI.exe adalah proses sistem yang dilindungi, jadi Windhawk tidak meng-inject ke dalamnya secara default. Agar mod ini berfungsi, kamu harus menambahkannya ke daftar inklusi proses Windhawk:

  1. Buka Windhawk lalu pergi ke Settings → Advanced settings → More advanced settings.
  2. Tambahkan LogonUI.exe ke Process inclusion list lalu simpan.

📋 Persyaratan

  • Windows 11
  • LogonUI.exe sudah ditambahkan ke daftar inklusi proses Windhawk (lihat di atas)
  • File video yang bisa dibaca akun SYSTEM. LogonUI.exe berjalan sebagai SYSTEM, sehingga lokasi jaringan, folder terenkripsi, dan file cloud-only (belum diunduh) mungkin tidak berfungsi.

⚙️ Fitur

Fitur Keterangan
Sumber video Satu file video, atau satu folder (video dipilih acak setiap kali dikunci)
Format mp4, m4v, mov, wmv, avi, mkv (apa pun yang bisa di-decode Media Foundation di sistemmu; MP4 H.264 disarankan)
Mode fit Cover, fill, fit (letterbox), center
Kecepatan putar 25% sampai 400%
Decoding hardware Men-decode di GPU (D3D11/DXVA) jika memungkinkan, dengan fallback otomatis ke decoding software
Penyesuaian warna Hue, saturasi, kecerahan, kontras, gamma
Audio Memutar audio video jika volume di atas 0
Hemat daya Mode gambar diam, jeda saat idle, dan opsi jeda di layar password
Perilaku saat boot Opsional menampilkan frame terakhir tepat setelah boot tanpa decoding
Layar shutdown Opsional menampilkan video di layar "Shutting down" / "Restarting" (mati secara default, sehingga layar hitam bawaan Windows yang tampil)
Fail-safe Mengembalikan wallpaper asli jika UI lock screen berubah atau mod bermasalah
Debug log Opsional: statistik CPU dan decode serta dump UI tree

📝 Catatan beberapa pengaturan

  • Render width: lebar kanvas internal (320 sampai 1920). Tinggi mengikuti rasio aspek layarmu. Ini pengaturan yang paling berpengaruh pada CPU.
  • Hardware video decoding: aktif (default) berarti video di-decode oleh GPU jika memungkinkan, sehingga pemakaian CPU turun jauh untuk video 4K atau 60 fps. Matikan jika pemutaran bermasalah atau layar sign-in bermasalah. Jika jalur GPU gagal menghasilkan frame, mod otomatis beralih ke decoding software. Mengubah setting ini juga menyalakan kembali pemutaran jika crash guard sempat mematikannya.
  • Behavior right after boot: dengan Show last frame, 3 menit pertama setelah boot menampilkan frame terakhir yang tersimpan tanpa decoding. Butuh minimal satu sesi sebelumnya di mana video sempat diputar.
  • Audio volume: 0 berarti senyap. Di atas 0, audio hanya diputar pada kecepatan 100% dan hanya saat video benar-benar berjalan (bukan saat dijeda, dijeda karena idle, atau menampilkan frame diam setelah boot).
  • Pause when idle: membekukan video dan membisukan audio setelah waktu tertentu tanpa input, lalu lanjut saat ada input berikutnya.
  • Play video on the password screen: aktif (default) berarti video tetap diputar saat kamu mengetik password. Jika dimatikan, video dibekukan di layar password (berguna jika video patah-patah di sana), dan diputar lagi di lock screen.
  • Debug log: juga menulis debug.log di folder penyimpanan mod, berisi statistik CPU dan decode setiap 5 detik dan satu kali dump UI tree. Peristiwa dasar selalu masuk ke log Windhawk (aktifkan logging untuk mod ini di Windhawk untuk melihatnya).
  • Pemutaran lama: video diulang tanpa batas waktu. Secara default video dibekukan setelah 5 menit tanpa input (lihat Pause when idle); setel ke 0 kalau kamu ingin video terus berjalan saat tidak ada orang di depan PC.

📈 Tips performa

  • Turunkan Render width (defaultnya 1920; misalnya coba 1280 atau 960).
  • Video 4K atau 60 fps di-decode oleh GPU saat Hardware video decoding aktif (default). Jika dimatikan, video di-decode oleh CPU dan bisa memakai beberapa core; pilih 1080p dengan 30 fps.
  • Gunakan Pause jika kamu hanya ingin gambar diam.
  • Biarkan Pause when idle aktif agar tidak ada decoding saat tidak ada orang di depan PC.
  • Jika video patah-patah saat mengetik password, matikan Play video on the password screen.
  • Layar password mem-blur wallpaper di belakangnya. Latar yang terus berubah membuat Windows mengulang blur itu di setiap frame, yang memakan sebagian GPU.

🔧 Pemecahan masalah

  • Wallpaper normal yang tampil: pastikan LogonUI.exe ada di daftar inklusi proses dan path video benar, lalu aktifkan Debug log dan baca debug.log di folder penyimpanan mod (lihat "File yang ditulis oleh mod"). Cari Failed to open video, Unsupported video format, atau FAIL-SAFE TRIPPED. Aktifkan Debug log untuk detail lebih banyak.
  • Video tidak mau terbuka: coba MP4 H.264 yang disimpan di tempat yang bisa dibaca akun SYSTEM.
  • Tidak ada suara: setel Audio volume di atas 0 dan baca catatan di atas.
  • Patah-patah: turunkan render width dan aktifkan Debug log, lalu cek baris CPU dan UI stalls di log.

🤔 Cara kerja

  1. Worker thread mencari LogonUI Logon Window dan memasang hook WH_GETMESSAGE pada UI thread-nya.
  2. Decoder thread membaca video sebagai RGB32 lewat Media Foundation, mengubah ukuran tiap frame sesuai mode fit, menerapkan pengaturan warna, lalu menaruhnya di buffer bersama.
  3. Di UI thread, frame terbaru disalin ke WriteableBitmap, yang dipasang sebagai source elemen LockLogonImage dan SwapLockLogonImage.
  4. Saat mod di-unload, source gambar asli dikembalikan.

🛡️ Fail-safe

Mod berhenti sendiri dan mengembalikan wallpaper asli sampai proses LogonUI.exe itu berakhir, jika:

  • decoder video gagal sebelum menghasilkan frame apa pun,
  • tidak ada frame video yang dihasilkan dalam 30 detik,
  • elemen lock screen (LockLogonImage / SwapLockLogonImage) tidak pernah ditemukan, yang biasanya berarti update Windows mengubah UI, atau
  • UI melempar error berulang (3 kali dalam 30 detik).

Selain itu, ada pelindung crash untuk layar sign-in. Jika dua sesi LogonUI.exe berturut-turut berakhir sebelum decoder menampilkan frame pertama (misalnya karena codec crash pada videomu), mod mematikan pemutaran dan wallpaper normal yang tampil. Untuk menyalakannya lagi, ubah Video file or folder, Render width, Fit mode atau Hardware video decoding ke nilai yang berbeda dan biarkan begitu. Sesi yang sangat singkat (misalnya dua kali layar Ctrl+Alt+Del berturut-turut) juga bisa memicunya; solusinya sama.

📁 File yang ditulis oleh mod

Semuanya disimpan di folder penyimpanan milik mod sendiri, di dalam folder data Windhawk (path di bawah untuk instalasi biasa; Windhawk portabel menyimpannya di tempat lain):

C:\ProgramData\Windhawk\Engine\ModsWritable\mod-storage\lock-screen-live-wallpaper

ProgramData adalah folder tersembunyi, jadi tempel path di atas ke address bar File Explorer untuk membukanya. Isinya:

  • debug.log: file log, dipangkas otomatis setelah 2 MB
  • frame_*.bgra: cache frame pertama, agar lock screen bisa langsung menampilkan sesuatu
  • last.bgra: frame terakhir yang ditampilkan, dipakai oleh mode boot Show last frame

Kamu boleh menghapus file-file ini kapan saja; mod akan membuat ulang yang dibutuhkan. Folder ini dihapus otomatis saat mod di-uninstall.

☕ Dukungan

Kalau kamu suka mod ini, kamu bisa mendukung pengembangannya lewat:

  • Saweria (untuk Indonesia)
  • Ko-fi (internasional)

ℹ️ Peringatan

Hanya diuji di Windows 11 23H2 dan 25H2. Mod ini berjalan di dalam proses UI sistem (LogonUI.exe), jadi sudah dilengkapi fail-safe yang mengembalikan wallpaper asli jika ada yang tidak beres. Sebagai langkah berjaga-jaga, siapkan cara lain untuk masuk ke Windows saat mencobanya.

entry.title: Quick Share Flyout 1.0.0
entry.content:
Quick Share Flyout

Opens Google's Quick Share for Windows as a flyout above the system tray, like the Windows 11 quick settings, instead of a window in the middle of the screen.

Click the Quick Share tray icon to open or close the flyout. If the icon is in the tray overflow menu, the flyout opens beside the menu.

Features

  • Opens above the tray icon and slides out from the taskbar
  • No title bar, with rounded corners
  • Stays above other windows, and closes when you click somewhere else
  • Drag files onto it from File Explorer
  • Moves notifications out of the way while it's open
  • Hidden from the taskbar and Alt+Tab
  • Adjustable size

Sending files

Drag files from File Explorer onto the flyout. It stays open while you drag and after you drop, until you click somewhere else. Clicking another window closes it, so pick the files first, then open the flyout and drag them in.

You can also right-click files and choose Send with Quick Share, or use Select in the flyout.

entry.content:
